scope: Eight educational entry-level role profiles; not current vacancies.

roles.title: Python Backend Developer
roles.description: Build APIs and reliable server-side applications.
roles.project: Build a Flask API with PostgreSQL, input validation and automated tests.

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Create responsive and accessible web interfaces.
roles.project: Build a responsive React dashboard with forms, API calls and keyboard navigation.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Turn raw data into reports that support decisions.
roles.project: Analyze a public dataset, write SQL queries and present a dashboard with conclusions.

roles.title: Machine Learning Intern
roles.description: Prepare data and evaluate simple predictive models.
roles.project: Train a classifier on a public dataset with separate test data and a confusion matrix.

roles.title: QA Engineer
roles.description: Test software and document reproducible defects.
roles.project: Create a test plan, automate browser tests and test a REST API with Postman.

roles.title: Cloud Support Associate
roles.description: Support cloud services and troubleshoot systems.
roles.project: Deploy a small containerized application and document networking and log troubleshooting.

roles.title: UI/UX Designer
roles.description: Design interfaces based on user needs.
roles.project: Interview three users, build wireframes in Figma and run a usability test.

roles.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.description: Understand network security and inspect incident evidence.
roles.project: Use an authorized local lab to inspect network traffic and create an incident report.

Python.step: Learn variables, functions and file handling.
Python.practice: Build a small CSV data-cleaning script.

SQL.step: Learn SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY and filters.
SQL.practice: Write five queries on a student-project database.

Flask.step: Learn routes, templates and request validation.

REST API.step: Learn HTTP methods, status codes and JSON.
REST API.practice: Create and test a small CRUD API.

Git.practice: Keep a project in Git with meaningful commits.

HTML.step: Learn semantic structure, forms and labels.

CSS.step: Learn spacing, Flexbox, Grid and responsive rules.
CSS.practice: Style a page for mobile and desktop.

JavaScript.step: Learn functions, arrays, events and fetch.
JavaScript.practice: Add validation and API fetching to a page.

React.step: Learn components, props, state and effects.

Excel.step: Practice formulas, filters and pivot tables.

Pandas.step: Learn DataFrames, missing values and groupby.
Pandas.practice: Clean and summarize a CSV dataset.

Data Visualization.step: Choose charts that clearly communicate comparisons.
Data Visualization.practice: Create three labeled plots and explain them.

Machine Learning.step: Learn train/test splits, overfitting and evaluation.
Machine Learning.practice: Compare two simple classifiers on held-out data.

Scikit-learn.step: Learn pipelines, fit, predict and metrics.
Scikit-learn.practice: Train and save a reproducible pipeline.

NumPy.step: Learn arrays, indexing and vector operations.

Statistics.step: Learn averages, variation, correlation and sampling.
Statistics.practice: Describe a dataset and its limitations.

Testing.step: Learn test cases, assertions and boundary cases.
Testing.practice: Write tests for a registration form.

Selenium.step: Learn browser locators, waits and assertions.

Postman.practice: Test the success and error responses of an API.

Linux.step: Learn shell commands, processes and permissions.
Linux.practice: Write a troubleshooting checklist for a local server.

AWS.step: Learn compute, storage, IAM and network basics.
AWS.practice: Design a small cloud deployment; check cost before provisioning.

Networking.step: Learn IP addresses, DNS, TCP and HTTP.
Networking.practice: Explain how a browser reaches a web server.

UI/UX.practice: Review a form and improve its usability.

Prototyping.step: Sketch screens and connect user journeys.
Prototyping.practice: Build and test a clickable prototype.

User Research.step: Ask neutral questions and record task observations.
User Research.practice: Run a small usability study with consent.

Cybersecurity.step: Learn security principles and authorized testing.
Cybersecurity.practice: Create a threat checklist for a local demo app.

Wireshark.step: Learn packet filters and protocol inspection.
Wireshark.practice: Inspect traffic only on a network you are authorized to use.

SIEM.step: Learn log collection, alerts and triage.
SIEM.practice: Write a simple log-based detection rule in a local lab.
